title_protection.quote: advertising in any manner that a registrant is registered under this chapter unless the advertisement includes an accurate reference to the contractor's or subcontractor's certificate of registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating without a certificate of registration issued by the director
disciplinary_grounds.quote: operating without a certificate of registration issued by the director

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning or failing to perform without justification any contract or project, or deviating from plans without owner consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: abandoning or failing to perform, without justification, any contract or project engaged in or undertaken by a registered contractor or subcontractor, or deviating from or disregarding plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the owner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to credit to the owner any payment made to the contractor or salesperson
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to credit to the owner any payment they have made to the contractor or his salesperson in connection with a residential contracting transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making material misrepresentations or false promises to induce procurement of a contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making any material misrepresentation in the procurement of a contract or making any false promise of a character likely to influence, persuade or induce the procurement of a contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly contracting beyond the scope of the registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly contracting beyond the scope of the registration as a contractor or subcontractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in connection with a residential contracting transaction to arrange or negotiate a mortgage loan
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acting directly, regardless of the receipt or the expectation of receipt of compensation or gain from the mortgage lender, in connection with a residential contracting transaction by preparing, offering or negotiating or attempting to or agreeing to prepare, arrange, offer or negotiate a mortgage loan on behalf of a mortgage lender

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing any advertisement that lacks registration number or contains false, deceptive, or misleading statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: publishing, directly or indirectly, any advertisement relating to home construction or home improvements which does not contain the contractor's or subcontractor's certificate of registration number or which does contain an assertion, representation or statement of fact which is false, deceptive, or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the building laws of the commonwealth or any political subdivision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of the building laws of the commonwealth or of any political subdivision thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting a material fact in obtaining a certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: misrepresenting a material fact by an applicant in obtaining a certificate of registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the director of any change of trade name or address
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to notify the director of any change of trade name or address as required by section thirteen

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting business under a name other than the registered name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conducting a residential contracting business in any name other than the one in which the contractor or subcontractor is registered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay for materials or services where sufficient funds were received
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to pay for materials or services rendered in connection with his operating as a contractor or subcontractor where he has received sufficient funds as payment for the particular construction work, project or operation for which the services or materials were rendered or purchased

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with any order, demand or requirement lawfully made by the administrator or fund administrator
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to comply with any order, demand or requirement lawfully made by the administrator or fund administrator under and within the authority of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demanding or receiving payment in violation of the deposit provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: demanding or receiving payment in violation of clause (6) of paragraph (a) of section two

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in gross fraud or cheat pursuant to statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in gross fraud or cheat pursuant to section 76 of chapter 266

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license or registration in another jurisdiction revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against for conduct that would constitute a basis for discipline in the commonwealth
disciplinary_grounds.quote: having a license, certificate, registration or authority issued by another state or territory of the United States, the District of Columbia or a foreign state or nation with authority to issue such a license, certificate, registration or authority revoked, cancelled, suspended, not renewed or otherwise acted against, or if the holder has been disciplined, if the basis for the action would constitute a basis for disciplinary action in the commonwealth

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to repay the guaranty fund in full for amounts paid due to contractor's conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to repay the fund in full, including the appropriate amount of annual interest, for any amount paid from the fund because of the contractor's or subcontractor's conduct

definition_quote.value: the reconstruction, alteration, renovation, repair, modernization, conversion, improvement, removal, or demolition, or the construction of an addition to any pre-existing owner occupied building containing at least one but not more than four dwelling units, which building or portion thereof is used or designed to be used as a residence or dwelling unit, or to structures which are adjacent to such residence or building
definition_quote.quote: the reconstruction, alteration, renovation, repair, modernization, conversion, improvement, removal, or demolition, or the construction of an addition to any pre-existing owner occupied building containing at least one but not more than four dwelling units, which building or portion thereof is used or designed to be used as a residence or dwelling unit, or to structures which are adjacent to such residence or building

methods_authorized.quote: the reconstruction, alteration, renovation, repair, modernization, conversion, improvement, removal, or demolition, or the construction of an addition to any pre-existing owner occupied building

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: Every contract, building permit and advertisement shall display the contractor's or subcontractor's certificate of registration number.

contract_must_be_written.quote: Every agreement to perform residential contracting services in an amount in excess of one thousand dollars shall be in writing

right_of_rescission_days.quote: of an owner's three-day cancellation rights under section forty-eight of chapter ninety-three

deposit_cap_fraction.value: one-third of the total contract price or the actual cost of any materials or equipment of a special order or custom made nature
deposit_cap_fraction.quote: Any deposit required under the contract to be paid in advance of the commencement of work under said contract shall not exceed the greater of one-third of the total contract price or the actual cost of any materials or equipment of a special order or custom made nature

deposit_cap_contract_threshold_usd.quote: Every agreement to perform residential contracting services in an amount in excess of one thousand dollars shall be in writing

arbitration_clause_allowed.quote: Any contract entered into between a contractor and homeowner may provide that the contractor may initiate alternative dispute resolution through any private arbitration services approved by the director

voidable_contract_clauses.quote: No contract shall contain an acceleration clause under which any part or all of the balance not yet due may be declared due and payable because the holder deems himself to be insecure.

minimum_annual_revenue_threshold_usd.quote: any person who engages in the business of a contractor or subcontractor on other than a full-time basis, and who has earned in gross revenues, as a contractor or subcontractor, less than five thousand dollars in the previous twelve-month period

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: any contractor or subcontractor who works on one undertaking or project by one or more contracts where the aggregate contract price is less than five hundred dollars

fraud_offense_defined.quote: engaging in gross fraud or cheat pursuant to section 76 of chapter 266

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: electricians, plumbers, architects or any other persons who are required by law to attain standards of competency or experience as a prerequisite to licensure for and engaging in such profession and who are acting exclusively within the scope of the profession for which they are currently licensed pursuant to such other law, construction supervisors excepted

out_of_state_disciplinary_action_reporti.quote: having a license, certificate, registration or authority issued by another state or territory of the United States, the District of Columbia or a foreign state or nation with authority to issue such a license, certificate, registration or authority revoked, cancelled, suspended, not renewed or otherwise acted against, or if the holder has been disciplined, if the basis for the action would constitute a basis for disciplinary action in the commonwealth
